extra.final_summary:
Penguins measured per island: Biscoe 32, Dream 17, Torgersen 10 (59 total).

Data quality: The island column had one label variant (" Torgersen" with a leading space, row 17) that would have split Torgersen into two groups; I merged it into the allowed label "Torgersen" with normalize_labels. No duplicate rows, no missing islands, and all island values are within the allowed labels.

Other issues noticed but not relevant to this question (left untouched): species has a lowercase "chinstrap" variant (row not used here), one missing sex value, and body_mass_g has a max of 3,650,000 g which exceeds the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g — worth reviewing if body mass is analyzed later.
